title: Cyclists' hearts: can you be so fit that you die?
summary: Medlife Crisis examines why some elite endurance athletes die in their sleep, covering extremely slow heart rates and the effects of performance-enhancing drugs that thicken blood. It uses cyclist Marco Pantani as an example.
why: HN recommends it as a good, short explanation of athlete's heart and the risks of extreme fitness.

quote.text: Medlife Crisis (a YouTube channel that deserves a much larger following) has a good video related to this topic
